rows.note: Use this when the stinginess is specifically about spending or keeping money.

example.english: They are so stingy about money that they will not even turn on the air conditioner.
example.traditional: 佢為咗慳錢，連冷氣都唔捨得開。
example.jyutping: keoi5 wai6 zo2 haan1 cin2 lin4 laang5 hei3 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 hoi1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who is generally unwilling to spend, give, or share.

example.english: He is really stingy and never agrees to chip in for a meal.
example.traditional: 佢真係好孤寒，次次食飯都唔肯夾錢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 gu1 hon4 ci3 ci3 sik6 faan6 dou1 m4 hang2 gaap3 cin2

rows.note: Use this when the person seems ungenerous or petty, especially about sharing, rather than specifically careful with money.

example.english: Do not be so stingy; you will not even share a piece of candy.
example.traditional: 你唔好咁小氣啦，食粒糖都唔肯分畀人。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 siu2 hei3 laa1 sik6 nap1 tong4 dou1 m4 hang2 fan1 bei2 jan4
